_notes: Southern Thousand Needles named-rare loot (2026-10-28). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3. Budget checked by audit() in tools/build_southern_needles_content.py. Rares are never quested.

The Thermal.name: Thermal-Rider's Longbow
The Thermal.flavor_text: It has not landed in anyone's memory. People have started checking.

The Thermal.name: Updraft Mantle
The Thermal.flavor_text: The heat comes off a mesa top all day and something has learned to live on it.

The Thermal.name: Carrion-Watcher's Coif
The Thermal.flavor_text: It is not waiting for you specifically. It is only waiting.

The Thermal.name: Sun-Scoured Greaves
The Thermal.flavor_text: Red stone holds the day's heat until about two in the morning.

The Thermal.name: Needle-Priest's Compendium
The Thermal.flavor_text: Bound with surgical thread, which it keeps for emergencies.
The Thermal.label: Tome (Spi)

Oldcrest.name: Oldcrest's Talonward
Oldcrest.flavor_text: She has held the Anvil since before the Lift fell and does not know it fell.

Oldcrest.name: Sheerwing Featherweave
Oldcrest.flavor_text: Harpies weave. Nobody who calls them animals has looked at the work.

Oldcrest.name: Unclimbable Spaulders
Oldcrest.flavor_text: Four mesas in this zone have no way up. Three of them are hers.

Oldcrest.name: Rooktender's Grips
Oldcrest.flavor_text: She feeds the ones that cannot fly yet, and there are always some.

Khan Saltmane.name: Saltmane's Toll-Taker
Khan Saltmane.flavor_text: The Sisters have a gap between them and he decided what it costs.

Khan Saltmane.name: Khan's Barded Breastplate
Khan Saltmane.flavor_text: Galak work, and good. They were never the savages Freewind needs them to be.

Khan Saltmane.name: Hoofguard Sabatons
Khan Saltmane.flavor_text: Centaur do not shoe. These go over, and they are somebody's idea.

Khan Saltmane.name: Windcatcher's Cord
Khan Saltmane.flavor_text: They read the thermals off the mesas the way a sailor reads water.

Khan Saltmane.name: Idol of the Long Winter
Khan Saltmane.flavor_text: Antler, bound with gut, and warm to hold in any weather.
Khan Saltmane.label: Idol (Str)

Panglass.name: Panglass Focus
Panglass.flavor_text: The pan behind it is fused to a sheet you can see your own face in.

Panglass.name: Fused Salt Pauldrons
Panglass.flavor_text: Whatever it does, it does to the ground first and to you second.

Panglass.name: Basilisk-Hide Jerkin
Panglass.flavor_text: Thick, cold, and it does not take dye.

Panglass.name: Dryhollow Wristguards
Panglass.flavor_text: The oldest, driest ground in the zone, and the furthest from anyone.
